mapper.sql: id, subject_id, task_id, title, source_record_id, status, next_review_date, last_result, interval_days, estimated_minutes, scheduled_date, added_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_item WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM review_item WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_review_date IS NOT NULL AND next_review_date <= #{date} ORDER BY next_review_date, id
SELECT FROM review_item WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_date = #{date} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_item (subject_id, task_id, title, source_record_id, status, next_review_date, last_result, interval_days, estimated_minutes, scheduled_date, added_at, version) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{taskId}, #{title}, #{sourceRecordId}, #{status}, #{nextReviewDate}, #{lastResult}, #{intervalDays}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{scheduledDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_item WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_date = #{date} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE review_item SET last_result = #{result}, interval_days = #{intervalDays}, next_review_date = #{nextReviewDate}, status = 'PENDING', scheduled_date = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE review_item SET status = #{status}, scheduled_date = #{scheduledDate}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, review_item_id, review_date, result, duration_minutes, note, next_review_date, interval_days, client_token, progress_delta, estimated_minutes FROM review_record WHERE review_item_id = #{reviewItemId} ORDER BY review_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, review_item_id, review_date, result, duration_minutes, note, next_review_date, interval_days, client_token, progress_delta, estimated_minutes FROM review_record WHERE client_token = #{clientToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_record (review_item_id, review_date, result, duration_minutes, note, next_review_date, interval_days, client_token, progress_delta, estimated_minutes) VALUES (#{reviewItemId}, #{reviewDate}, #{result}, #{durationMinutes}, #{note}, #{nextReviewDate}, #{intervalDays}, #{clientToken}, #{progressDelta}, #{estimatedMinutes})
mapper.update: UPDATE review_item SET version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.subject_id, i.title, LEAST(COALESCE(r.percent_done, 0), 100) AS completion_percent, COALESCE(r.estimate, i.estimated_minutes) AS estimated_minutes, COALESCE(r.minutes, 0) AS actual_minutes, COALESCE(r.missing_durations, 0) AS missing_durations, i.version, (i.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND i.scheduled_date = #{date}) AS actionable FROM review_item i LEFT JOIN (SELECT review_item_id, SUM(progress_delta) AS percent_done, SUM(duration_minutes) AS minutes, SUM(duration_minutes IS NULL) AS missing_durations, MAX(estimated_minutes) AS estimate FROM review_record WHERE review_date = #{date} GROUP BY review_item_id) r ON r.review_item_id = i.id WHERE (i.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND i.scheduled_date = #{date}) OR r.review_item_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.id
